  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {k : ℕ} (D : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RelativeAnnularGenerators.AnnularDatum { real := S, gamma := ∅ } k)
  (w : Fin (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.labN D) → M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.mk D (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.hd D w)

    w :=

    D w =>
  funext fun i =>
    Fin.addCases
      (fun i =>
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.hd D w)
                  (Fin.append ![DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.tg D w]
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.lb D w))

      (fun i =>
        Fin.addCases
          (fun i =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans
                      (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.hd D w)
                        (Fin.append ![w (Fin.natAdd (1 + k) (Fin.castAdd D.chart.arity 0))]
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.lb D w))
                        (Fin.castAdd D.chart.arity i))

                        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.lb D w) i)))
                  (w (Fin.natAdd (1 + k) (Fin.castAdd D.chart.arity i)))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      ![w (Fin.natAdd (1 + k) (Fin.castAdd D.chart.arity 0))] _a =
                        w (Fin.natAdd (1 + k) (Fin.castAdd D.chart.arity _a)))
                    (Subsingleton.elim i 0)))
                (Eq.refl (![w (Fin.natAdd (1 + k) (Fin.castAdd D.chart.arity 0))] 0))))
          (fun i =>
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans
                      (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.hd D w)
                        (Fin.append ![DiamondIntegral.Section7.BlowupLiftImage.tg D w]

      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) (F '' I) :=

    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.image_real hG
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex n m);
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun y =>
      {

          Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
              right ▸
                have hh := funext (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_head n m x (F x));
                have ht := funext (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_tail n m x (F x));

                                  DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex n m)
                            hh))
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => F x = _a) ht)) (Eq.refl (F x)))⟩,
                    ht⟩,

          Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hw right =>
              right ▸ Exists.intro (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex n m) ⟨hw.left, hw.right⟩ };

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece : ∀ {M : Type} {n m : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → M) → Fin m → M}
  {A P Q : Set (Fin n → M)} {C : Set (Fin m → M)},
  Set.BijOn f A C → A = P ∪ Q → Disjoint P Q → C \ f '' (A ∩ Q) = f '' (A ∩ P)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece : ∀ {M : Type} {n m : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → M) → Fin m → M}
  {A P Q : Set (Fin n → M)} {C : Set (Fin m → M)},
  Set.BijOn f A C → A = P ∪ Q → Disjoint P Q → C \ f '' (A ∩ Q) = f '' (A ∩ P) :=
fun {M} {n m} {f} {A P Q} {C} hf hA hPQ =>
  Set.ext fun y =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hy hnot =>
          Exists.casesOn (hf.right.right hy) fun x h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y => y ∈ C → y ∉ f '' (A ∩ Q) → y ∈ f '' (A ∩ P))
                (fun hy hnot =>
                  have hx' := hA ▸ hx;
                  Or.casesOn hx' (fun hp => Exists.intro x ⟨⟨hx, hp⟩, rfl⟩) fun hq =>
                    absurd (Exists.intro x ⟨⟨hx, hq⟩, rfl⟩) hnot)
                right hy hnot,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left right =>
            And.casesOn left fun hx hp =>
              right ▸
                ⟨hf.left hx, fun a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun x' h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun left he =>
                      And.casesOn left fun hx' hq =>
                        have hxx := hf.right.left hx' hx he;
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x ∈ A → x ∈ P → f x' = f x → False)
                          (fun hx hp he => Set.disjoint_left.mp hPQ hp hq) hxx hx hp he⟩ }
'DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.graph_diff_definable : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {m n : ℕ} (I J : Set (Fin m → M))
  (F : (Fin m → M) → Fin n → M),
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.graphOn I F) →
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
        (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) J →
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
        (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.graphOn (I \ J) F) :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
    [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {m n} I J F hG hJ =>
  have hP :=
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.preimage_real hJ
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex n m);
  have h :=
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.inter hG
      (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.compl hP);
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun M sM hM B n sn A A' e'_7 =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
            A' = a →
              e'_7 ≍ x →
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B sn A ≍
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B sn A')
            e'_7
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun A' =>
                ∀ (e_7 : A = A'),
                  e_7 ≍ Eq.refl A →
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B sn A ≍
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B sn A')
                (fun e_7 h => HEq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B sn A))
                (Eq.symm h) e'_7)
            (Eq.refl A') (HEq.refl e'_7))
        M inst hM B (n + m) (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.graphOn (I \ J) F)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.graphOn I F ∩
          ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) \
            {z |
              z ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex n m ∈ J ∧
                z ∈
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
                    SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv}))
        (Set.ext fun w =>
          {
            mp := fun hw =>
              have hg := ⟨hw.left.left, hw.right⟩;
              ⟨hg,
                ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.proper hG w hg, fun hp =>
                  hw.left.right hp.left⟩⟩,
            mpr := fun hw => ⟨⟨hw.left.left, fun hj => hw.right.right ⟨hj, hw.right.left⟩⟩, hw.left.right⟩ })))
    h

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {k : ℕ}
  (r : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart B k) (τ : DiamondIntegral.Section4.AnnularBlowup.Aperture r)
  (w : Fin (1 + (1 + r.arity)) → M),
  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ↔
    w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
          (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧
        1 <
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
              (w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx r)) ∧
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx r)) ≤
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
              ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryComparison.cancel_gamma : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (a t s : G),
  a * t * (s * t⁻¹) = a * s
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryComparison.cancel_gamma.{u_1} : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G]
  (a t s : G), a * t * (s * t⁻¹) = a * s :=
fun {G} [CommGroup G] a t s =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => a * t * _a = a * s) (mul_comm s t⁻¹)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = a * s) (Eq.symm (mul_assoc (a * t) t⁻¹ s))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * s = a * s) (mul_assoc a t t⁻¹)))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {k : ℕ}
  {a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart { real := S, gamma := ∅ } k}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Iso a b),
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase { real := S, gamma := ∅ }
    (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.graphOn a.domain (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw F)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {k}
    {a b} F =>
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun w =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔ w ∈ {w | ∃ u, w = DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u)})
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVRealProducts.graphOn_exists a.domain
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw F) w))))
        {
          mp := fun a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun x h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
                Eq.symm right ▸
                  Exists.intro ⟨x, hx⟩
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.scalarDef_coord : ∀ {M : Type}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.scalarDef_coord : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {n : ℕ} {I : Set (Fin n → M)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) I →
    ∀ (p : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.ScalarDef B I fun u => u p :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {n}
    {I} hI p =>
  have h := DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVCoordinateMaps.coordinate_graph_definable B I hI ![p];
  have he :=
    funext fun u =>
      funext fun i =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
          List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i) (Fintype.complete i)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i)
                (fun this tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      (u ∘ ![p]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) =
                        ![u p] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))
                    (fun h => Eq.refl ((u ∘ ![p]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i)
                (fun tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                    ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                      Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                        (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i)
                    (fun a h =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.paradigm_zero_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},

    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A).Nonempty →
      (t₁ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M ↔ t₂ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) :=

    {t₁ t₂} h hne =>

    {
      mp := fun h1 =>
        have hfib := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre_of_zero_left h h1 ha;
        Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_surjective t₂) fun s hs =>
          have hmem := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => s + f a ∈ _a) (h.fibre_eq a ha))) (Exists.intro s ⟨hs, rfl⟩);
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) (Eq.symm hs)))

                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext add_eq_right))
                    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext Set.mem_singleton_iff))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.slope_eq : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A f t₁ t₂ →
    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A).Nonempty →
      ∀ {s : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M},
        DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.HasSlope (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A) f s →
          ↑s * t₁ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₂ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {A} {f}
    {t₁ t₂} h hne {s} hs =>
  Exists.casesOn hne fun a ha =>
    Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_surjective t₂) fun s₂ hs₂ =>
      have hmem := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => s₂ + f a ∈ _a) (h.fibre_eq a ha))) (Exists.intro s₂ ⟨hs₂, rfl⟩);
      Exists.casesOn (h.bijective.right.right (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.mem_second_of_fibre hmem))
        fun a' h_1 =>
        And.casesOn h_1 fun ha' he =>
          have hpre :=
            ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext Set.mem_preimage)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre A a) he)) hmem),
              ha'⟩;
          Exists.casesOn (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => a' ∈ _a) (h.preimage_eq a ha)) hpre) fun s₁ h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hs₁ hs₁e =>
              have hslope := hs a' ha' a ha;
              have hneg :=
                id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-s₁) = _a)
                        (Eq.symm (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-1) s₁))))
